purpose: Teach: 悪党/対局/貧血/中性/土砂/憂い/ぞっと/手遅れ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、組織的な、絶対、悪党、絶対、警察、絶対、検挙、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're pursuing this case with full seriousness. We believe we're dealing with an organized criminal element, and we're committed to making an arrest.
lines.style: Measured and professional. Steady eye contact, measured pace. Conviction without drama. The tone of someone who has briefed superiors and means every word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者間の、本気で、絶対、対局、絶対、状態、絶対、警察、絶対、見極めて、絶対、いらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So you're saying the police have a clear picture of how the suspects are connected to each other?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly leaning forward. Genuine curiosity — not doubting, asking to understand the fuller picture. Respectful pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者の、本気で、絶対、貧血、絶対、症状、絶対、医療チームと、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've confirmed the victim's condition with the medical team. The anemia symptoms are documented.
lines.style: Clinical tone, slightly quieter. Moving through facts methodically. Not cold — just precise. The voice of someone checking boxes that matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現場の、本気で、絶対、中性、絶対、洗剤、絶対、警察、絶対、証拠として、絶対、収集されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And the neutral detergent found at the scene — that's been collected as evidence by the department?
lines.style: Careful question, gently inquisitive. Trying to understand the connection without presuming. Respectful of the officer's expertise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。豪雨の、本気で、絶対、土砂、絶対、災害現場、絶対、警察、絶対、出動、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When the heavy rains triggered the landslide at the disaster site, we deployed immediately to secure the area.
lines.style: Factual and direct. Slight shift in register — this is connected to the wider incident. Professional pride in the deployment. Not rushing the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者家族の、本気for、絶対、憂い、絶対、警察、絶対、配慮されているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I gather the police are being thoughtful about how you're treating the victim's family through all this?
lines.style: Gentle observation, not quite a question. Acknowledging the human side of the investigation. Warm respect underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件現場で、本気で、絶対、ぞっと、絶対、する、絶対、証拠、絶対、警察、絶対、確認しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. At the scene, we identified evidence that gave us pause. We've verified it carefully.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. The word 'pause' carries weight — this is something that struck the officer. Slower pace on the verification. Not distant, just honest about what was found.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害が、本気で、絶対、手遅れ、絶対、にならぬよう、絶対、警察、絶対、迅速対応、絶対、いただいているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police responded quickly enough that we can still help the victim. That matters.
lines.style: Soft conclusion. Not celebratory — reflective. Understanding that time made the difference. Voice trailing slightly, like breathing out something held in.
